python.gram and Tokens are Grammar/python.gram and Grammar/Tokens of CPython 3.14.8, copied
unchanged. The grammar tests read python.gram as it is (ADR 1000, decision 2) and compare the
left-recursive rules polypiler-tooling grammar read finds with those pegen reports
(Tools/peg_generator, compute_left_recursives), recorded in GrammarCommandTests.
